name: JW Marriott Maldives Resort & Spa
positioning: Villa resort on a private island in the Maldives' Shaviyani Atoll, with overwater and beach pool villas, an overwater spa and a kids' club
best_for: Families wanting a kids' club and a two-bedroom beach villa with butler service
Couples wanting an overwater pool villa and an overwater spa

facts.text: The resort is on a private island in Shaviyani Atoll.
Accommodation is in overwater villas and beach villas with private pools and decks overlooking the Indian Ocean.
Each villa terrace has a private wooden deck, a pool and an outdoor shower.
The Duplex Overwater Pool Villa has an infinity pool and lets guests snorkel right from the villa.
The Two Bedroom Duplex Beach Pool Villa has direct beach access and personal Thakuru (butler) service.
Spa by JW treatments are inspired by four benefit states: Calm, Indulge, Invigorate and Renew.
Spa by JW uses products from Aromatherapy Associates.
The spa's Island Touch is a 120-minute treatment for two in the deluxe spa suite, with access to the couple's steam bath and ice room.
Activities include snorkeling, scuba diving, jet-skiing and sailing.
The Dive & Water Sports Center offers kitesurfing, parasailing, kayaking and paddle boarding.
Kaashi is a Thai restaurant set in a treetop location with views of the Indian Ocean.
Hashi is a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant in an overwater location.

highlights.text: Spa by JW is an overwater spa set above the Indian Ocean.
The villas' thatched roofs recall upside-down Dhoni boats, the traditional wooden fishing vessels of the Maldives, and the slanted roof tips recall white herons dipping their heads into the water.
The Duplex Overwater Pool Villas have a master bedroom and an upstairs lounge with views of the Laccadive Sea.
The Little Griffins Kids' Club has a pirate ship and more than 100 activities, from treasure hunts and snorkeling to arts, sports and science experiments.
The resort has an open-air overwater yoga pavilion.

considerations.text: The resort runs on Island Time, an hour ahead of the capital, Male.
Velana International Airport is about 192 km from the resort.
Spa by JW requires an appointment and does not take online reservations.
